```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Todo List</title>
    @livewireStyles
    <link href="{{ asset('css/app.css') }}" rel="stylesheet">
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-900 text-white font-sans antialiased">
    <div class="container mx-auto p-4">
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold mb-6">Todo List</h1>

        <input wire:model.live="newTodo" type="text" placeholder="Add new todo..." class="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded border-gray-500 focus:border-blue-400 focus:ring-blue-400">
        
        @if ($todos)
            <ul class="space-y-2 list-disc pl-8">
                @foreach ($todos as $todo)
                    <li>
                        {{ $todo }}
                        <button wire:click.prevent="deleteTodo({{ $todo }})" class="text-red-500 ml-4 text-sm">Delete</button>
                    </li>
                @endforeach
            </ul>
        @else
            <p>No todos yet.</p>
        @endif

        @if ($errors->any())
            <div class="bg-red-100 border-l-4 border-red-500 text-red-700 px-4 py-3 rounded relative mt-2">
                @foreach ($errors->all() as $error)
                    <p class="block">{{ $error }}</p>
                @endforeach
            </div>
        @endif
    </div>

    @livewireScripts
</body>
</html>
```
